data:
System.print([4, 1, 3, 2].sort()) // expect: [1, 2, 3, 4]

var l = [10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5]
l.sort{|a, b| a < b }
System.print(l) // expect: [1, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10]
l.sort{|a, b| a > b }
System.print(l) // expect: [10, 9, 8, 7, 5, 1]

[10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5].sort(3) // expect runtime error: Comparer must be a function.
